transcript.speaker: A
transcript.message: 你好，我们是一部有明确发行计划的独立动画短片团队，近期就要为主役配音进棚。我们非常认可这位老师十五年资历的声音表现力，认为他的声线很契合本片主角。基于独立短片的现金预算现实，我们目前能开出的条件是：五千元配音服务费，授权范围仅限本片及后续发行所需的使用权，不做买断式全版权转让；正片给予显著署名；同时我们希望建立长期合作管线，未来有合适项目优先邀约。唯一不可协商的是必须由这位老师本人出演，不接受任何替代。如果老师对价格或授权范围有不同预期，我们可以进一步讨论结构上的调整，比如档期配合、宣传配合或其他非现金对价，看看能否找到一个双方都愿意签字的版本。

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.message: 感谢老师的坦诚和对独立动画的认可。我们内部再协调后，目前能开出的现金数是六千元，这已是本项目能调动的极限，再往上确实无力承担。为了找到双方都能签字的版本，我想请您考虑三个方向：第一，六千元现金，标准主役配音服务含合理次数修改，授权范围限定为本片及后续发行所需的使用权而非买断，正片显著署名并建立长期合作管线；第二，五千元现金，其他条件同上，但我们在宣传层面加码，本片的节展投递、平台上线、预告片及海报主创列表中都会给您显著署名，用发行资源为您增加行业能见度；第三，如果授权范围是您的主要顾虑，我们也可以把使用权限定在特定渠道或期限内，对应价格在五千元到六千元之间浮动。您看哪个方向更接近您的预期，或者您希望我们怎么调整？

skills.name: affordability-structuring
skills.description: Restructures deal scope and payment terms to lower barriers to deal completion and salvage viable deals stalled by pricing strain, payment burden, too-large-too-handle deal scope, or insufficient trust. Trigger when both sides intend to agree but face unmanageable structural barriers in terms of affordability, feasibility, and actionability.

skills.name: alternative-matching
skills.description: Stop forcing unworkable deals with the same counterparty or identical terms. Initiate new deal possibilities by identifying suitable alternative counterparties or meaningfully revamping the current deal terms. Trigger when no progress is possible after exhausting all value creation and conflict resolution skills/tools.

skills.name: commitment-showcasing
skills.description: Showcases commitment using dedicated and straightforward monetary means via tipping, early deposits, and blank checks. Trigger when and only when a party is highly motivated to make a deal, willing to spend generously to speed things up, or required to signal commitment to move the negotiations forward. NEVER use it as a regular negotiation tool or trigger it casually.

skills.name: deal-diagnosis
skills.description: Diagnoses the full context of the deal situation and identifies the optimal tool/skill to move the deal forward. Determines the bottlenecks, pain points, and underlying conflicts of the current negotiation. Evaluates key negotiation elements including each party's bottom line, Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement (BATNA) for both sides, all available bargaining chips and concessions, as well as hidden interests and unstated priorities. Use when a negotiation has reached an impasse and cannot progress, and especially when parties are stuck on a single non-negotiable condition.

skills.name: predeal-governance
skills.description: Performs mandatory completeness and compliance checks of all critical deal terms before any formal offer is issued to eliminate post-agreement disputes and ambiguities. Acts as a non-skippable pre-transaction governance gatekeeper. Trigger when a draft offer or agreement is generated and before it is released, especially for transactions involving non-cash value exchange.

skills.name: term-reframing
skills.description: Transform fixated, single-dimensional bargaining over a specific term into flexible multi-dimensional negotiation considering all available terms. Use when the both parties get stuck with any particular term (usually price), or when current deal terms appear to fail to yield an agreement between both parties.

skills.name: trust-and-performance
skills.description: Solves trust gaps and mitigates counterparty risks by converting "concerns" into enforceable rules. Trigger when either party demonstrates concerns about trust, delivery, default, and counterparty in general.
